bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
w="$r/.worktrees/room-error-class-1f3575b"
old="$r/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
new="$w/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-error-class-1f3575b
backup=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-before-error-class
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = 1f3575b8ad7a509afe7ef4ec4489f0b9d0f8870b || exit 70
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 71
userbot_pid=$(systemctl --user show gace-userbot-verify.service -p MainPID --value)
pg_id=$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.Id}}')
old_id=$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')
test "$old_id" = "$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}')" || exit 72
new_id=$(docker image inspect "$tag" --format '{{.Id}}')
test "$new_id" != "$old_id" || exit 73
docker compose -p deploy -f "$new" --project-directory "$r/deploy" config -q || exit 74
docker tag "$old_id" "$backup"
rollback() {
 docker tag "$backup" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -p deploy -f "$old" --project-directory "$r/deploy" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs || :
 echo GAYBBS_ROLLBACK_REQUESTED
}
trap rollback ERR
docker tag "$tag" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
docker compose -p deploy -f "$new" --project-directory "$r/deploy" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs || exit 75
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
 if test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true && docker logs --since 4m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -q GAYBBS_BOT_READY; then break; fi
 sleep 1
done
docker logs --since 4m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -q GAYBBS_BOT_READY || exit 76
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$new_id" || exit 77
test "$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$pg_id" || exit 78
test "$(systemctl --user show gace-userbot-verify.service -p MainPID --value)" = "$userbot_pid" || exit 79
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.RestartCount}}')" = 0 || exit 80
trap - ERR
echo ROOM_EDIT_ERROR_CLASSIFIER_PRODUCTION_PASS
echo POSTGRES_AND_USERBOT_UNCHANGED_PASS
echo SOURCE_SHA=1f3575b8ad7a509afe7ef4ec4489f0b9d0f8870b
